<CLT=cltSYSTEM>When you need to deduce a keyword, you will
be thrown into <CLT=cltSTRONG>Hangman's Gambit Ver3.0<CLT=cltSYSTEM>!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>The objective is to select the <CLT=cltSTRONG>letter orbs<CLT=cltSYSTEM>
in the right order to <CLT=cltSTRONG>create the keyword<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Press <PAD=【○】> to activate the <CLT=cltSTRONG>flash spot<CLT=cltSYSTEM>
to read the illuminated <CLT=cltSTRONG>letter orbs<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>While the letters are <CLT=cltSTRONG>illuminated<CLT=cltSYSTEM>, you will not
be able to actually select a <CLT=cltSTRONG>letter orb<CLT=cltSYSTEM>...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>So make sure you remember where they are and
press <PAD=【△】> to <CLT=cltSTRONG>get the letter orb<CLT=cltSYSTEM>!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>But remember, you have to select
them in the <CLT=cltSTRONG>correct order<CLT=cltSYSTEM>...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM><CLT=cltSTRONG>Deduce the keywords<CLT=cltSYSTEM> from the letter orbs
that you can see in the flash spot.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>The flash spot uses <CLT=cltSTRONG>focus energy<CLT=cltSYSTEM>,
so use it wisely!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Waves of light will also occasionally cross
the screen, so you can read the letter orbs then!
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>So take advantage of that as well!
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Thank you for listening to me!
